title: Iran Hits Bahrain, Defies US Blockade. In 1962 a Blockade Nearly Meant Nuclear War #shorts
description:
This week Iran launched attacks on Bahrain and the Strait of Hormuz and moved against the US naval blockade. In October 1962, a US naval blockade of Cuba brought the United States and the Soviet Union to the brink of nuclear war.
